title: Set whether an obligation applies, per entity and per unit, one confirmed call at a time or many

acceptance: REG-S1 (dialog steps are the journey's; say so in app.md), REG-S2, REG-S12 un-skipped; a read writes no row (counted); bulk is all or nothing with one audit per row and a pinned query count; over REGISTER_BULK_MAX answers 422 and stores nothing; register suite green.

Single set (obligation, entity or unit): value, reason, decided_at, decided_by, one record() naming the person, before, after, reason; If-Match; no step-up; a scope row is created only in the write's transaction through ensure_register_entry(). Bulk: rows may target obligations, entities or units (paste reuses this; unit rows resolve once c8-reg-units lands the table in this wave, so test unit rows in c8-units-paste-soa), REGISTER_BULK_MAX (100, env override). Never touches status or gaps. Register TENANT_SCOPED_ROUTES entries for id routes that are tenant-scoped (a unit id). Keep: 'applies' and 'we comply' separate.

brief: Read R2_CROSS_CUTTING.md. Implement the stubs for GET and PATCH /obligations/{id}/register and PATCH .../entities/{orgUnitId}: status, note, risk, first-line owner, contact, owner team, process, system, evidence location, next review; per scope row its own status, note, owner or team, next review with If-Match. One function ranks worst-of by category kind, never label. REG-S4 (applicability toggle) is c8-inventory-overlay's.

The riskAcceptances count is x-decide-now-counts'.

brief: Read R2_CROSS_CUTTING.md, ADR 0048. passkey_is_compliant(passkey, policy) does not trust the library's result alone. Registration path only; sign-in is c11-signin-policy-use's. Keep: no passwords, no fallback.

title: The agents client, and the console's definitions, settings and platform runs
goal: features/agents types every agent operation, and platform admins publish versions, set platform settings and read platform runs.
acceptance: All console and tenant agent operations, budget and research requests typed in features/agents with presentations for every status; list, versions with publish (change note, UI step-up) and retire, settings with the 'for every bank' notice behind step-up, runs panel linking to Sources; loading, empty, error and denied states; frontend gates pass.
brief: Read R2_CROSS_CUTTING.md. Journeys AGT-S4 and ADM-S4 are c11-e2e-console's.

title: Decide a batch row by row, apply the scope changes
goal: A second person approves or rejects batch rows with a passkey and approved rows rewrite obligation terms in one transaction.
acceptance: PRO-S8 un-skipped (twelve rows previewed, two rejected, ten changed, one batch event); a rejection needs a reason row; the proposer (and the person who asked for a re-tag) gets 409 four_eyes_violation; one audit per row and one naming each row's outcome, all in one transaction with reindex; any agent key deciding answers 409 person_review_required; PRO-04 cell.
brief: Read R2_CROSS_CUTTING.md. Fill batch.decide and add apply()'s obligation_scope branch (terms before and after in its audit row), inside the proposal door. Person decisions only, with a passkey; the four-eyes CHECK stays the database's word, and the re-tag requester refusal sits in batch.decide. The agent path waits for Alex's answer on who decides a re-tag batch and is not in this plan; nothing here waits for it.

title: Seeded agents, runs, budget and a batch for the chunk 11 journeys
goal: Journeys find a second sweeper version, tenant A's own agent with runs and a near cap, and an open twelve-row batch.
acceptance: Rerun changes nothing; a month boundary leaves the spend figure alone; tenant B has no agent and no budget; the batch comes from batch.create_batch().
brief: Read R2_CROSS_CUTTING.md. A fixture folder or second sweeper version for AGT-S4; tenant A's tenant-source-watch agent weekly with a scope, runs over recent weeks with costs near a seeded cap; platform runs; anchored to the seed clock.

title: Batch review and 'Ask for a re-tag' in the console
goal: Editors review a batch row by row with a passkey and ask for a re-tag.
acceptance: A batch is one queue entry; preview with row approve/reject and a reason; Approve the rest and Reject all behind step-up; four_eyes_violation state; result with counts and audit link; readable at 375 px; re-tag form follows its request to the batch; frontend gates pass.
brief: Read R2_CROSS_CUTTING.md. PRO-S8's journey is c11-e2e-console's.

title: Agent-access credentials resolve to an entry or a person, read only, rate-limited
goal: Principals carry credential kind, entry and acting person; every agent-access credential is read-only and refused step-up.
acceptance: A revoked or inactive entry's key refused on the next request; a personal token dies with its person, membership or backing permission and holds only scopes its permissions back; unbound tenant keys grant nothing through tenant:read; SessionAuth never accepts a token; every mutating route 403 read_only_credential except allow-listed POST /search, /agent-access/what-applies, /mcp; step-up routes give tokens 403 step_up_required; per-credential rate limit 429 with a security-log row; a walk over every operation fails on a new unguarded route; audit rows name entry or person; the D-78 zone guard still passes; security review of your diff.
brief: Read R2_CROSS_CUTTING.md, AGENT_ACCESS.md, ADRs 0055-0057, D-78. Scope mapping: library:read -> library.read, search:read -> search.use, upcoming:read -> roadmap.read, tenant:read -> register.read. No agent-access credential reaches a library write, a footprint write or a proposal route. Stop and report on any invariant question.

title: An entry's scope from its departments and products, and tenant reach behind two people
goal: Entry scope is derived per request and only narrows; tenant reach needs a request and a second person's passkey.
acceptance: ACC-S2 un-skipped; the SQL predicate over a term map matches the pure answer and keeps FP-01's empty-dimension and opt-in rules; naming nothing narrows nothing; naming departments or products that derive no terms reads nothing with a reason; reach tables under forced RLS; reach request, approve (requester 409 four_eyes_violation, backed by CHECK decided_by <> requested_by), reject and switch-off each need security.manage and a step-up; switch-off immediate; tenant_reach_on(tenant) exposed; audit rows name each person with the assertion; ACC-02 cell.
brief: Read R2_CROSS_CUTTING.md, D-70, D-77. Entry terms: the named products' terms plus products under each named department and its sub-units, intersected with the footprint, never stored and never taken from the caller. TenantReachRequest with CHECK decided_by <> requested_by, one pending per tenant, joins FOUR_EYES_TABLES; a one-row reach state, default off; both forced RLS.

title: Proposals owned by a bank, and the bank's own queue declared
goal: A proposal can belong to one bank, set by the server, under split RLS that keeps owned rows out of the console, and the private queue routes exist at 501.
acceptance: owner_tenant_id set by logic.create from the target, the filing session's bank for a private-record kind, or a worker run's bank, never the body; forced RLS in the split shape proven as cw_app, so a console session reads no owned row; PRIVATE_RECORDS_APPROVE for Compliance officer and Approver only, never a platform role or key scope; GET /private-proposals, POST /private-proposals/{id}/approve (step-up) and /reject answer 501 after loading under RLS (another bank 404); the door guard names the approve route; the four-eyes CHECK is unchanged.
brief: Built under D-89 (Alex, 2026-09-24); PRD 0.7's OWN group is the spec. Read R2_CROSS_CUTTING.md, D-57, ADR 0050, ADR 0059, CHUNK13_TASKS c13-private-contract. You own proposals/logic.py this wave for owner resolution in create() only; approve and reject reuse is d89-private-records'. The console queue excludes owned rows by the database policy, not by a filter. No API key scope gains anything.

title: The scope-researcher agent definition
goal: A tenant-scoped definition researches one approved scope item from public sources into the bank's own proposals.
acceptance: Definition scope tenant, tenant_configurable true, writes_to tenant, a tool list with no library-writing, footprint-writing or key-scoped write operation; inputs are the item's jurisdiction and regime keys and id only; every field sourced; AGT-08 sector-scope and standards rules; fetched content screened as untrusted; evaluation rows and gate follow the sweeper's pattern; seed loader and README entries.
brief: Built under D-89; the item's free-text fields reach it only after Alex answers the tenant-text question. Read R2_CROSS_CUTTING.md, AGT-07, AGT-08, D-32, ADR 0059.

acceptance: ADM-S18 journey un-fixmed (an editor proposes a Danish label change, a second editor approves with step-up, the regulatory scope screen shows the new label); ADM-S4's note updated; frontend gates pass.
